what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Denmark in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 50 Danish asylum seekers, and Canada hosted 48.0% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are the United States, Australia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Denmark, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2019, 2021 to 2022 and 2024 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
